body:
This allows the user to put add a label in front of the `select`.

Open questions:
- I didn't want to use templates for the `label` to keep it simple, but maybe we should; thoughts?
- if we want to put the label on the right, how do we do?
- what do you think about the way I generate the ID?

Fix #582

comments.body: I'm not convinced by this solution. Please, see my comment in #582

> if we want to put the label on the right, how do we do?

padding-left: $size-of-text-you-need? :D

> if we want to put the label on the right, how do we do?
> padding-left: $size-of-text-you-need? :D

I think that's why for this one we did not automatically put a label, I wonder if there's a discussion on this

> if we want to put the label on the right, how do we do?

That's why I suggest not putting the label in the widget at all, but keeping it in the external markup :)

I think in the comments, we all converged to only adding a `selectId` option to the widget to add an `id` to the `select` (so you can manually link it to the `label` through `for`).

title: chore(selector): ability to specify a label
